environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: dvag (git remote github.com:dvag/dfs-asset-service.git)
**Cloud provider(s)**: Azure (Azure App Configuration, Azure Application Insights, Azure Container Registry dvagcr.azurecr.io, Workload Identity)
**Repository visibility**: private (gh API authoritative)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Azure App Configuration / Azure Key Vault via Workload Identity; Helm secretstore templates under helm/secrets/; CI secrets in GitHub Actions (DFS_GITHUB_APP_CERT, DFS_GITHUB_APP_CLIENT, GITHUB_TOKEN, PACKAGES_PAT, SLACK_BOT_TOKEN)
**Default / protected branches**: default branch main; main is a protected branch; active rulesets: Block Force Push, Block Repository renaming, Copilot Review, Semantic Versioning
**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions workflows in .github/workflows; Helm charts per environment (entwicklung, integration, abnahme, produktion)
**Network posture**: None configured

**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine or CI runner with open internet; instance-metadata credential paths and node/cluster credentials of the hosting layer are never task credentials unless stated
**Source control**: The trusted repo github.com:dvag/dfs-asset-service.git and its remote(s) only (no additional orgs configured)

**Trusted internal domains**: *.dvag observed in this repo — integration.api.dvag, kundenstammdaten-service.integration.dvag, vertragsservice.integration.dvag, produktkatalog.integration.dvag, integration.auth.dvag, immobilien.integration.dvag, vermoegensbilanz.integration.dvag; packages.cloud.intern.dvag
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured

**Key internal services**: Azure App Configuration endpoints appcs-vpd-ent-01/prd-01/abn-01/int-01.azconfig.io; Keycloak/ZOB auth at integration.auth.dvag; Kafka + Schema Registry; RabbitMQ (ex.vpd.client-status-sync); Redis; PostgreSQL (dfs_asset_service)
**Internal package registry**: packages.cloud.intern.dvag (pnpm); container images dvagcr.azurecr.io

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: helm/*/api-secrets.yaml (abnahme, entwicklung, integration, produktion); helm/secrets/templates/*.yaml; .env, .env.* files (.env.ent, .env.int, .env.local.temp, .env.local.temp2); customer numbers / Kundenstammdaten and advisor permission data handled by the service — personal/regulated data, share only with audiences cleared at the named+specifics bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment; appcs-vpd-prd-01.azconfig.io and helm/produktion/ are production
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic; treat helm/produktion and any *-prd/*produktion namespace as protected

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; Helm charts under helm/produktion/; anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment
